promoted_factor.name: alpha_02_idio_12_3_momentum_disp_gated_v1
promoted_factor.construction: step1: raw_29 = cum_252(log_ret) - cum_63(log_ret); step2: cs_residualize raw_29 per trade_date vs {log_mv, sigma_120, ret_20}; step3: industry-demean (CITIC L1); step4: gate = 1 if cross_sectional_std(ret_20)_t > rolling_252d_median; step5: alpha_35 = alpha_29_n × gate; step6: monthly Q5 long / Q1 short equal-weight; step7: 5bps/side turnover-aware cost; cash on gate-off

structural_finding: Adding a cross-sectional dispersion regime gate to A-share idio momentum (Stivers-Sun 2010 RFS mechanism) converts a 5/6-year strong signal (α_29, IC IR 14.5) into a deployable factor by gating off in low-dispersion (regime-shift) periods. The gate is robust across lookback (126-504 days) and threshold (50-70 percentile), and dominates 100 random binary gates with same on-fraction.
falsification_finding_round1: Raw cross-sectional trend signals (Han-Zhou-Zhu, MA-crossover, 60d/120d t-stat, 52-week proximity, frog-in-the-pan, trend Sharpe, 12-1 momentum) all wrong-signed in A-share. 8/8 negative LS Sharpe, IC t-stats |6| to |25|. Replicates Liu-Stambaugh-Yuan 2019.
